lead: A `pub(crate)` stream type in a `Wire<S>` default fails 48 times in `nvs-stdlib` and never names the cause.
body: `MySqlRows<'a, S = MyStream>` is public, so the default is part of its signature and every stdlib line holding rows becomes a `private type` error pointing at the caller. Make the stream `pub` and re-export it beside the rows type in the same edit — `PgRows` and `TdsRows` carry the same default.
